title: The $400K Social Security Trick 40% of Couples Miss
hook: If you've been married, there's a Social Security benefit most people never claim — and the average couple walks away from $400,000 by never knowing it exists.
angle: The Social Security spousal benefit is one of the most underused entitlements in America — fully legal, completely free, and almost nobody knows the rules around divorced eligibility
audience: Married couples and divorced Americans ages 45-65 approaching retirement
key_numbers: Up to 50% of spouse's Social Security benefit
40% of eligible spouses never claim it
$400,000+ lifetime income left on the table
32.5% benefit at age 62 vs 50% at full retirement age 67
10-year marriage rule for divorced spousal claims
